converse.emptyText: Pick a graph and start the conversation.
converse.emptyVoice: Press start and say something. What you say appears as you speak it.
converse.halfDuplexHelp: Stops the microphone while the assistant talks. Use it if the assistant interrupts itself through your speakers; headphones solve the same problem.
converse.insecureContext: A microphone needs a secure context. localhost works; a LAN address over plain http:// does not — use https or open the UI on the machine itself.
converse.requires: Needs a microphone and the voice graph running: skills/asr, skills/llm-chat, skills/sentence-chunker and skills/tts.
converse.voiceGraphHelp: Voice runs the `voice` graph: speech to text, a model, a sentence chunker and speech synthesis, all at once.
